name: MOW_RULE_SET_DETAILS
description: Table to store the additional work object attributes for a rule set.

columns.name: RULE_SET_DETAIL_GUID
columns.description: Primary Key to uniquely identify the row

columns.name: RULE_SET_ID
columns.description: Identifier field to uniquely identify the row

columns.name: RULE_SET_NUMBER
columns.description: PUID to uniquely identify the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Created By Party Id

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Last Updated By Party Id

columns.name: USE_SCORE_FLAG
columns.description: indicates if Assignment Mode is Matching with Score

columns.name: RULE_SET_GROUP_GUID
columns.description: Foreign Key to the MOW_RULE_SET_GROUP_ENTITIES

columns.name: RECORD_STATUS
columns.description: Indicates if RuleSet has been published to Engine

columns.name: REF_ROW_GUID
columns.description: Reference key the to respective N/D row.

columns.name: INACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if RuleSet is active or not. By Default RuleSets are Active.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the beginning of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the end of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: The Description of Rule Set

columns.name: OWNER_MODULE
columns.description: Indicates the owning component of the Rule Set Details

columns.name: RULE_SET_NAME
columns.description: Name of the Rule Set

columns.name: WORK_OBJECT_GUID
columns.description: Work Object Guid. Foreign Key to the MOW_ASGN_OBJECTS_B table

columns.name: CANDIDATE_OBJECT_GUID
columns.description: Candidate Object Guid. Foreign Key to the MOW_ASGN_OBJECTS_B table

columns.name: RULE_TYPE
columns.description: The Rule Type

columns.name: MIN_SCORE
columns.description: Minimum score of the candidate

columns.name: MAX_SCORE
columns.description: Maximum score of the candidate

columns.name: NO_OF_CANDIDATES
columns.description: Number of Candidates

columns.name: FILTER_TYPE
columns.description: Column to store the filter type code.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
